title.narrative: Improving Access to Health Services for Disadvantaged Groups Investment Program (Tranche 2)

description.narrative: On 11 October 2019, the Asian Development Bank (ADB) approved the Improving Access to Health Services for Disadvantaged Groups Investment Program under the multitranche financing facility (MFF) modality. The implementation period is from 2019 to 2029 and consists of three tranches, implemented by the executing agency, the Ministry of Health (MOH). The program responds to Mongolia's current health system challenges, including inadequate provision and quality of PHC, inefficient secondary health services, and limited financial and procurement capacity. The program remains aligned with the State Policy on Health 2017-2026, Health Sector Strategic Plan 2022-2025, and the Government of Mongolia Action Plan 2024-2028. 10 The facility supports six of eight health policy areas through infrastructure development, capacity-building, improvements in primary health care, strengthening secondary health care services, improving the government's health financing and improving procurement systems. It supports Mongolia's long-term objectives to ensure universal health coverage, and improve the quality and capacity of health services. 13 The program's impact is the health status of Mongolians improved. The outcome is access to affordable quality primary and secondary health services in Khovd and Uvs aimag, Ulaanbaatar ger areas, and selected soum improved. The outputs are (i) urban and rural PHC strengthened, (ii) district and aimag hospital services improved, (iii) the health financing system strengthened, and (iv) the procurement and financial management capacity of government health entities strengthened. The program's framework financing agreement (FFA) was signed on 19 September 2019 and ratified by the Mongolian Parliament on 6 December 2019.
